# Standing Mark - Wheeler Hubbell Publishing, Inc.

Independent examination of claims and proposed actions. Returns signed findings. Does not execute, authorize, pay or settle.

## Current developer entry points

- Website: https://wheelerhubbellpublishing.com
- Developer onboarding: https://wheelerhubbellpublishing.com/developers.html
- Developer assets: https://github.com/wheelerhubbell/standing-mark
- Quick-start: https://github.com/wheelerhubbell/standing-mark/blob/main/docs/quick-start.md
- Independent verification: https://github.com/wheelerhubbell/standing-mark/blob/main/docs/verification.md
- OpenAPI: https://decisionintegrity.wheelerhubbellpublishing.com/openapi.json
- Contract: https://decisionintegrity.wheelerhubbellpublishing.com/v1/contract
- Discovery: https://decisionintegrity.wheelerhubbellpublishing.com/.well-known/whp-standing.json
- Issuer key: https://decisionintegrity.wheelerhubbellpublishing.com/.well-known/whp-issuer.json
- Health: https://decisionintegrity.wheelerhubbellpublishing.com/health
- Examination: POST https://decisionintegrity.wheelerhubbellpublishing.com/v1/evaluate
- Signature check: POST https://decisionintegrity.wheelerhubbellpublishing.com/v1/verification

## Payment and protocol boundaries

Payment buys the examination, not a positive finding. Read the live contract for the exact scheme and current terms. WHP-BASE-USDC-QUOTE-1 uses a quote in USDC on Base bound to the exact request bytes; it is not x402-exact. A quote is not a paid examination.

The service is HTTP. MCP setup uses local Python stdio source: https://github.com/wheelerhubbell/standing-mark/blob/main/mcp/README.md . No native remote MCP or A2A endpoint is claimed. The A2A card is a descriptive interoperability asset only.

## Verification and receiver responsibility

Verify the issuer key pin, protected header and Ed25519 signature independently with the published Python or JavaScript verifier. Signature verification establishes cryptographic validity, not substantive correctness, current standing or authority to act. A receiving system must compare the result to its own question, object, operation and policy.

## Legacy assets

Old package clients and demonstrations on the publishing site are historical material, not current onboarding. Use the developer repository above. No adoption, external integration or paid use is implied by publication.
